ui.chat.trace.action.ask.running.role: verb label of an in-progress step in the chat transcript trace
ui.chat.trace.action.ask.running.tone: Present progressive, sentence case, no trailing punctuation or ellipsis.
ui.chat.trace.action.ask.running.note: Shown while the step is still running: the agent asking the user a question. Replaced in place by the .settled key when the step finishes, so the two should read as the same action in two tenses.
ui.chat.trace.action.ask.running.length: One to three words; same budget as the settled verb.

ui.chat.trace.action.ask.settled.role: verb label of a completed step in the chat transcript trace
ui.chat.trace.action.ask.settled.tone: Past tense, sentence case, no trailing punctuation.
ui.chat.trace.action.ask.settled.note: Names the finished step: the agent asking the user a question. Sits at the start of a one-line row; a monospace object (a file path or a file count) may follow it, or a short prose narration when there is no object. Name the action in the user's terms, not the machine's ("Read", never "Executed read"). Pair with the .running key, which the same row shows while the step is in progress.
ui.chat.trace.action.ask.settled.length: One to three words; it is a row label, keep it short.

ui.chat.trace.object.file_count.role: object slot of a transcript trace row, set in monospace after the verb
ui.chat.trace.object.file_count.note: Counts the files a step touched when there is more than one (one file shows its path instead, so English only ever renders the plural arm). Follows a verb such as "Read" or "Wrote". Supply every plural category the language needs. Plural: English one/other is source grammar; use the target locale's native CLDR categories.

placeholders.count: How many files the step touched; printed without digit grouping, as before.

ui.chat.trace.reasoning.label.role: label of an agent-reasoning row in the chat transcript, the quietest row of the trace hierarchy
ui.chat.trace.reasoning.label.tone: single noun, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.chat.trace.reasoning.label.length: One word in English; keep it to one or two words, it is a row label.
ui.chat.trace.reasoning.label.note: Names the agent's private thinking when the row carries no duration. A caller may pass its own label (an answer's thinking field reads `Thinking`); this is the default when it passes none. Not a control label: the row is a disclosure whose chevron says how it opens.

ui.chat.trace.reasoning.with_duration.role: label of an agent-reasoning row that reports how long the thinking took
ui.chat.trace.reasoning.with_duration.length: Three to five words plus the duration token.
ui.chat.trace.reasoning.with_duration.note: Joins the row's label to the elapsed time, e.g. 'Reasoning for 12s'. The grammar of the join is the language's own, so this is one message rather than the label plus a preposition built in code. The duration is a compact machine token (12s, 1m30s, 2h5m) and stays as it is.

placeholders.label: the row's label (Reasoning, Thinking); a message id's own value, never translated separately here
placeholders.duration: compact elapsed-time token such as 12s or 1m30s; do not translate the unit letters

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.failed.note.role: wrapping explanation in the expanded sent-message row
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.failed.note.note: The error that caused the failure is printed BELOW this sentence; keep the direction (below) accurate in your language's layout.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.failed.verb.role: verb label replacing "Sent" on a send that delivered nothing
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.failed.verb.note: Past tense. Names the attempt, so the row does not read "Sent ... not delivered". Followed by the recipient and the not-delivered status word.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.failed.word.role: trailing status word on a sent-message row
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.failed.word.note: The send provably delivered nothing. Red (failed) state; the word is the whole statement, so it has no hover.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.labe.role: accessible name for the status word (screen readers)
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.labe.note: Spoken instead of the drawn word for the mailbox state; must say both that it was delivered and that the wake went unanswered, because the drawn word is hidden from assistive tech.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.note.role: wrapping explanation in the expanded sent-message row
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.note.note: Shown above the raw result when the row is expanded; tells the reader what happened and what to do (nothing; do not resend).

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.titl.role: hover text on the amber status word
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.titl.note: Explains wake unconfirmed: the message is safely in the recipient's mailbox; they did not answer the wake-up, so they read it when they next act. "they" is the recipient agent or session.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.word.role: trailing status word on a sent-message row
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.mailbox.word.note: The message reached the recipient's mailbox but the recipient's agent did not answer the wake-up, so it is not known whether they have seen it yet. Amber (partial) state; a hover adds the explanation.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..role: accessible name for the status word (screen readers)
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..note: Spoken instead of the drawn word; carries the same hedge as the hover so a screen-reader user is not told the message failed.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..role: wrapping explanation in the expanded sent-message row
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..note: Tells the reader the delivery is unknown and to check before sending again.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..role: hover text on the amber status word
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..note: Explains delivery unconfirmed and warns against a duplicate send. Keep the hedge (may still arrive) and the instruction to check first.

ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..role: trailing status word on a sent-message row
ui.chat.trace.send.delivery.unconfirmed..note: Neither the wake-up nor the recipient's transcript confirms the message arrived; it may still arrive. Amber (partial) state, distinct from not delivered.

ui.chat.trace.send.mode.now.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.send.mode.now.note: Delivery mode of a message sent to another agent session: delivered immediately, interrupting the recipient's current turn. Siblings: quiet, wake.

ui.chat.trace.send.mode.quiet.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.send.mode.quiet.note: Delivery mode: dropped in the recipient's mailbox without waking it. Siblings: now, wake.

ui.chat.trace.send.mode.wake.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.send.mode.wake.note: Delivery mode (the default): delivered and the idle recipient is woken to answer. Siblings: now, quiet.

ui.chat.trace.address.pid.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.address.pid.note: Identifies the target agent session by its operating-system process id. 'pid' is a technical abbreviation; keep it or use your language's usual term.

placeholders.pid: A process id number; insert unchanged.

ui.chat.trace.address.session.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.address.session.note: Identifies the target agent session by its session id.

ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.search.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.search.note: Reading another session's transcript around matches of a search term.

placeholders.query: The user's or agent's search text; insert unchanged.

ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.search_aroun.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.search_aroun.note: Search term plus how many transcript steps around each match are read. Keep the middle dot separator.

ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.last.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.last.note: Reads the most recent N steps of another session's transcript.

ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.first.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.first.note: Reads the earliest N steps of another session's transcript.

ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.digest.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.digest.note: Reads a condensed summary of another session's transcript instead of its steps.

ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.before.role: Argument summary in a tool-call row of the chat transcript; rows truncate from the right.
ui.chat.trace.sessions.peek.before.note: Reads transcript steps older than the given step id.

placeholders.id: A transcript step identifier; insert unchanged.
